[[FC Sète]] won '''Division 1 season 1938/1939''', the last professional football season before [[World War II]], of the [[Ligue de Football Professionnel|French Association Football League]].

Promoted from [[Ligue 2|Division 2]], who would play in [[French soccer Division 1 1945/1946|Division 1 season 1945/1946]] (With the beginning of [[World War II]], relegations and promotions are only taken into account after the end of the war i.e. for season 1945/1946)
* [[Red Star Olympique]]: Champion of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]]
* [[Stade Rennais UC]]: Runner-up [[Ligue 2|Division 2]]
